name: Tangmarg–Baramulla National Highway
significance: NH 701A is a branch of NH 701. In the national highway numbering used since 2010, a letter after the number marks a spur or link off the main route — this one runs Tangmarg to Baramulla, and it meets NH 701 along the way.

relatedRoads.label: NH 701 — the highway this branch takes its number from, running Baramulla to Chilhana
